universe_header: # S&P 100 constituents, as listed on the Wikipedia page below
# ticker form is the page's; Yahoo symbol = ticker with '.' replaced by '-' (oos_basket.yahoo_symbol)

params.k_rule: basket n_ranked // 4; benchmark all eligible names
params.sizing: equal weight of current equity at each rebalance, fractional shares, cash 0-1% after fills
params.schedule: last trading session of each month; trade at next session open
params.adv: point-in-time mean(close*volume) over 63 sessions ending on rebalance day
params.eligibility: rankable only with a full point-in-time ADV window
